name: org.machanism.machai:project-layout
description: Project Layout is a Java 8 utility library that detects and describes conventional repository layouts for Maven, Gradle, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Python projects. It provides a common, root-relative API for production source, test, and documentation locations; discovers Maven modules and JavaScript workspaces; reads Maven pom.xml metadata; and supplies a fallback layout for unrecognized repositories. Build tools, plugins, repository scanners, code generators, documentation systems, validators, and project-indexing services use it to avoid duplicating ecosystem-specific directory rules. ProjectLayoutManager selects a suitable layout from a project root, while ProjectProcessor supplies a reusable module-aware traversal workflow.

constructors.description: Creates a Maven-aware layout. Configure the project root with projectDir(java.io.File), then obtain Maven source, test, documentation, and module paths.

examples.description: Creates and configures a Maven layout for a repository before reading its production source roots.

constructors.description: Creates a Gradle-aware layout that uses the Gradle Tooling API and conventional src/main, src/test, and src/site locations.

examples.description: Configures a Gradle project root and retrieves child module identifiers.

constructors.description: Creates a JavaScript and TypeScript layout that recognizes package.json and can resolve workspace modules.

examples.description: Configures a package.json project and reads its workspace module paths.

constructors.description: Creates a Python project layout used to detect Python metadata and project indicators.

examples.description: Checks a repository for pyproject.toml, setup metadata, requirements, or Python project structure.

constructors.description: Creates the fallback layout for repositories that do not match a supported ecosystem-specific model.

examples.description: Uses the fallback implementation to enumerate immediate non-excluded directories.

constructors.description: Creates a utility for parsing Maven pom.xml files, applying available property substitutions, and serializing Maven models.

examples.description: Loads Maven metadata for a tool that needs the artifact model.

features.name: detectProjectLayout
features.description: Detects Maven, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or fallback project layouts from a project directory. Use this as the primary entry point when the repository type is not known in advance.

examples.description: Automatically selects the repository layout and retrieves root-relative documentation directories.

features.name: getSources
features.description: Returns root-relative production source directories resolved by the selected layout implementation. Maven layouts include configured or default source and resource locations.

examples.description: Resolves each layout-provided source path against the configured project directory for scanning.

features.name: getModules
features.description: Returns module directories declared by a Maven project whose packaging is pom; returns null when the project is not a Maven parent project.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.project.layout.MavenProjectLayout layout = new org.machanism.machai.project.layout.MavenProjectLayout().projectDir(new java.io.File("C:\\work\\parent"));
java.util.List<java.lang.String> modules = layout.getModules();
examples.description: Obtains Maven reactor module paths from a parent pom.xml.

features.name: getProjectModel
features.description: Loads a Maven model from pom.xml after lightweight property substitution. Throws java.lang.IllegalArgumentException when the POM cannot be processed.

examples.snippet:
org.apache.maven.model.Model model = new org.machanism.machai.project.layout.PomReader().getProjectModel(new java.io.File("C:\\work\\repository\\pom.xml"));
java.lang.String artifactId = model.getArtifactId();
examples.description: Reads an artifact identifier from project Maven metadata.

features.name: scanFolder
features.description: Scans a project root, detects modules, and delegates each module or the root layout to a ProjectProcessor subclass implementation.

examples.description: Invokes a custom processor that implements project-specific indexing for a single or multi-module repository.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout
studs.description: Base contract for project-layout implementations. Extend it to add source, test, documentation, and module-discovery rules for another ecosystem.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.project.ProjectProcessor
studs.description: Module-aware traversal contract. Extend it and implement processFolder(org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout) to perform work for each detected project layout.

examples.title: Install, configure, and use Project Layout in a Maven repository scanner
steps: Add the org.machanism.machai:project-layout:1.3.0 dependency to the consuming Maven project's pom.xml.
Run mvn clean verify to resolve the dependency and build the consuming application.
Configure the scanner with the filesystem path of the repository to inspect.
Call org.machanism.machai.project.ProjectLayoutManager.detectProjectLayout(java.io.File), then use getSources(), getTests(), and getDocuments() to drive scanning.
examples.description: A practical integration scenario: install the library as a Maven dependency, pass a repository path through the repository.dir JVM property, detect the project type, and enumerate production source directories for a scanner. Run the consuming application with -Drepository.dir=C:\work\repository.
